patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout with a fixed, oversized brand logo on the left and a scrollable content area on the right.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif typography is used for section titles and course names, creating strong visual hierarchy against smaller, functional body text.
A monochromatic base palette of black, white, and light gray dominates the UI, allowing the vibrant, detailed 3D renders within content sections to provide visual accents.
A sticky header, comprising a prominent logo and navigation, maintains brand presence and site access as the user scrolls down the page.
Each course is presented as a distinct, full-width visual block featuring a unique, high-fidelity 3D render as its primary visual identifier.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth, controlled scrolling experience, likely using locomotive-scroll, where content sections appear to glide into view with subtle easing rather than snapping.
A persistent, oversized brand logo is fixed to the left side of the viewport, acting as a background element that content scrolls over, creating a layered depth effect and strong brand reinforcement.
The main navigation and a smaller version of the logo become a sticky header at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, ensuring constant access to key site sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, functional sans-serif body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all UI elements, contributing to a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, with full-width content blocks creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, asymmetrical layout that dedicates significant screen real estate to a fixed, oversized brand logo on the left, creating a strong, persistent brand presence. This, combined with the full-bleed, high-fidelity 3D rendered course visuals, elevates the experience beyond a typical e-learning platform into something akin to a digital art gallery.
